# Aerumna
A biological experiment gone wrong. A miserable failure by every sense of the word. Aerumna is a very recently found moon, and is not present on original Confederate prospecting records. Strange.
According to basic prospecting scans, a significant fraction of the planet is covered in strange biomass that no amount of immolation can fully remove. There is simply too much. Seas of Letoferol line the surface, rivers running through the biomass as it uses the fluid like a bloodstream to hold nutrients. The planet itself is something from eldritch horror.
While the flesh has consumed almost everything on this planet, some trace anomalous minerals remain. However, the risk assosciated with diving into the horror largely outweighs the potential rewards. [color=red]Some factions would pay lavishly if you were to be able to destroy this hazard somehow, or at least purge it of its plauge.[/color]
